links.comparator_used: Plain AI review without knowledge augmentation (model's own knowledge), run on the same 213 prescriptions
links.effect: Hallucination rate fell from 19.7% (42/213) to 4.7% (10/213), an absolute reduction of 15.0 percentage points (relative reduction 76.2%; P<.001)
links.quote: Knowledge augmentation reduced the model hallucination rate from 19.7% (42/213 prescriptions) to 4.7% (10/213), an absolute reduction of 15.0 percentage points (relative reduction 76.2%; P<.001).

links.effect: 97.2% (207/213, 95% CI 94.0%-98.7%) in the human-AI collaborative condition vs 82.6% (176/213, 95% CI 77.0%-87.1%) in the pharmacist-alone condition (P<.001)
links.quote: Overall review accuracy was 97.2% (207/213, 95% CI 94.0%-98.7%) in the human-AI collaborative condition vs 82.6% (176/213, 95% CI 77.0%-87.1%) in the pharmacist-alone condition (P<.001).
